filePrompt: Choose a file or drop it here.
changeWarning: Reloading the page loses unsaved work. Continue?
jspiUnavailable: This build requires a browser with WebAssembly JSPI support. Please update your browser.
downloadReady: The file is ready. Click Download to save a copy to your device. The browser cache is separate from this download. You can retry Download if the file picker is canceled.
openSource: Choose where to open the file from.
bundlePrompt: Download {filename} from GitHub Releases, then choose or drop it here. The file stays on your device.
bundleCache: The loaded bundle is cached in this browser. If browser storage is cleared, select the file again.
clearRuntimeCache: Remove the cached runtime and retry? If loading fails, select a bundle again. Saved drawings are kept.
